idea-plugin.name: Pi Agent Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Agent Launcher

One-click Pi coding agent launcher for JetBrains IDEs — keeps the Pi coding agent CLI one click away inside the IDE.

Important: Install the Pi CLI separately before using this plugin.
npm i -g @anthropic-ai/pi-coding-agent or visit pi.dev

Features

  • One-click launch from the toolbar
  • Integrated terminal that opens a dedicated "Pi" tab inside the Terminal tool window
  • Send to Pi — select code, right-click, and send file reference (@path/file.go#L10-25) to the active terminal
  • Copy reference — right-click code or a file to copy @path/file.go#L10-25 to the clipboard
  • Auto-open files — files Pi reports as modified open in the editor. The list comes from a bundled pi extension (no project-wide file watching)
  • Configurable notifications for Pi file changes, startup/exit and clipboard copies
  • Flexible configuration for models, thinking levels, and launch options

Usage

Quick Start

  1. Click the pi button in the main toolbar.
  2. A new "Pi" tab opens in the Terminal window and runs pi automatically.
  3. Select code, right-click, then Send to Pi to add file context to your prompt.

Configuration

Open Settings, Tools, Pi Agent to pick the model, thinking level, --no-themes, notification and auto-open options.

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Cmd+Esc (Mac) / Ctrl+Esc (Win/Linux) — Launch or focus Pi
  • Cmd+Shift+P (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+P (Win/Linux) — Send selection to Pi

Supported IDEs

Works with all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, and more.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.12

  • Send selection/file references to the currently active terminal tab, including a Pi started manually (no extra Pi tab is opened)
  • New actions: Copy Code Reference and Copy File Reference to the clipboard
  • --no-themes is now a setting (Settings, Tools, Pi Agent)
  • All notifications are configurable: file changes, Pi startup/exit, clipboard copies
  • Terminal detection now supports both the legacy and the new terminal engines (WebStorm 2025.3+)
  • Project View file references read PSI/navigatable/selected items, so Send/Copy File Reference is enabled again in the new UI
  • Test build: the Pi tab is created with the classic engine and without stealing focus (requestFocus=false), so the terminal "save all documents on focus" path cannot deadlock the EDT; open the Terminal window or click the tab to interact
  • Fixed intermittent IDE freezes after launching Pi from the toolbar: the project-wide file watcher (and its VFS-listener editor opening) is gone, the launch command is typed only after the shell session is really up, and the Pi process scan no longer runs on the EDT
  • File-change tracking is back, and exact: the plugin ships a small pi extension that reports every file a tool call modifies. It is installed to ~/.pi/agent/extensions/pi-ide-bridge.ts, is inert unless Pi was started from the IDE, and is only ever replaced by a newer bundled version
  • Concurrent Pi instances (or several IDE windows) are counted per pi session, so "Pi modified N files" no longer mixes the work of two sessions

0.1.1

  • Pi now opens as a tab inside the Terminal tool window (alongside Local)
  • Removed standalone Pi Agent tool window
  • Reflection-based terminal API for zero deprecated warnings

0.1.0

  • Initial release
  • One-click launch from toolbar
  • Send selection as file reference (@path#Lstart-end)
  • Auto-open files modified by Pi
  • Completion notifications
  • Settings panel: model selection, thinking level, custom args
  • Models loaded from ~/.pi/agent/models.json
